citations.quote: Incident folder on the NAS (`\\HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\<yyyy-mm-dd>-<tail>\`): the incident log, photos, GCS screenshots, telemetry, link logs, DAA-1 recording, notification record, Incident Repor

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Emergency Response Plan for Flight Operations (ERP)
citations.headingPath: ERP › Section 8 › 8.4 Unknown drone over a Group site or during a public event at the adjacent Harwick Fairgrounds
citations.quote: - The Group has no counter-UAS capability and **does not interfere with, capture, jam, or fly at another aircraft**. Interfering with an aircraft is a federal offense regardless of who flies it. - Ove

snapshot.title: Drone Image from Detection Vendor — Serial Mismatch

fields.imageBrief: Close-up of a DJI Matrice 350 drone with visible serial 'RID-BM-12-004' on undercarriage, red LED light on top, circling over a crowd in a suburban fairground setting, motion blur on propellers, partially obscured by distant trees

snapshot.instructorNote: This image confirms the drone's identity and serial; the ASO must cross-check the serial against the fleet register. The mismatch is critical for establishing the drone is not Group-owned.
